keywords: OpenTelemetry, W3C Trace Context, Context Propagation, Standards

question.t: 您正在為一個遺留系統 (Legacy System) 編寫自定義的 HTTP 客戶端中介軟體，目標是將其整合到公司現有的 OpenTelemetry 分散式追蹤網格中。
question.en: You are writing custom HTTP client middleware for a legacy system with the goal of integrating it into the company's existing OpenTelemetry distributed tracing mesh.

question.t: 為了確保追蹤上下文 (Trace Context) 能符合業界標準並正確傳遞給下游的 OTel 服務，您必須在 HTTP 請求標頭中注入下列哪一個欄位？
question.en: To ensure the Trace Context complies with industry standards and is correctly propagated to downstream OTel services, which of the following fields must you inject into the HTTP request headers?

options.t: (A) X-B3-TraceId 與 X-B3-SpanId
options.en: (A) X-B3-TraceId and X-B3-SpanId

options.t: (B) traceparent
options.en: (B) traceparent

options.t: (C) ot-tracer-spanid
options.en: (C) ot-tracer-spanid

options.t: (D) correlation-id
options.en: (D) correlation-id

why.t: OpenTelemetry 採用 W3C Trace Context 作為官方推薦的標準傳播格式，其核心標頭為 `traceparent` (包含 version, trace-id, parent-id, trace-flags)。雖然 B3 (Zipkin) 仍被廣泛支援，但在 OTel 原生環境中，W3C 標準是首選。
why.en: OpenTelemetry adopts W3C Trace Context as the officially recommended standard propagation format, with the core header being `traceparent` (containing version, trace-id, parent-id, trace-flags). While B3 (Zipkin) is still widely supported, the W3C standard is the preferred choice in native OTel environments.

keywords: OpenTelemetry Collector, PII, Data Privacy, Processors

question.t: 在一次安全稽核中，發現應用程式的 Span 屬性 (Attributes) 中意外記錄了使用者的敏感個資 (PII)，例如電子郵件地址。
question.en: During a security audit, it was discovered that sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII), such as email addresses, was accidentally recorded in application Span attributes.

question.t: 由於目前處於嚴格的程式碼凍結期 (Code Freeze)，您無法立即修改並重新部署應用程式程式碼。
question.en: Due to a strict code freeze currently in effect, you cannot immediately modify and redeploy the application code.

question.t: 作為 OpenTelemetry Collector 的維運負責人，您應採取什麼行動來最快解決此合規風險？
question.en: As the operator responsible for the OpenTelemetry Collector, what action should you take to mitigate this compliance risk most quickly?

options.t: (A) 暫停 Collector 服務直到程式碼修復為止。
options.en: (A) Suspend the Collector service until the code is fixed.

options.t: (B) 在 Collector 的 pipeline 中配置處理器 (Processor)，對特定屬性進行遮罩 (Masking) 或雜湊 (Hashing)。
options.en: (B) Configure a processor in the Collector pipeline to mask or hash specific attributes.

options.t: (C) 增加採樣率 (Sampling Rate) 以稀釋敏感資料出現的頻率。
options.en: (C) Increase the sampling rate to dilute the frequency of sensitive data appearances.

options.t: (D) 在後端儲存系統 (如 Elasticsearch) 設定定期刪除腳本。
options.en: (D) Set up a periodic deletion script in the backend storage system (e.g., Elasticsearch).

why.t: OTel Collector 的核心價值之一是解耦應用程式與後端。透過配置 `attributes` 或 `transform` processor，可以在數據匯出前清洗掉 PII，無需觸碰應用程式程式碼，這是最快且最安全的緩解措施。
why.en: One of the core values of the OTel Collector is decoupling the application from the backend. By configuring an `attributes` or `transform` processor, you can scrub PII before data export without touching the application code, which is the fastest and safest mitigation.

keywords: Alerting, SLO, Golden Signals, Monitoring vs Observability

question.t: 根據「監控告訴你系統是否壞了 (IF)，可觀測性告訴你為什麼 (WHY)」的原則，在設定關鍵服務的 On-call 告警 (Alerting) 時，
question.en: Based on the principle that "Monitoring tells you IF the system is broken, Observability tells you WHY", when setting up On-call alerting for a critical service,

question.t: 下列何者最適合設為觸發工程師半夜起床處理的緊急告警 (Page)？
question.en: Which of the following is most suitable as an emergency alert (Page) that triggers an engineer to wake up at night?

options.t: (A) CPU 使用率 > 90% (CPU Usage > 90%)
options.en: (A) CPU Usage > 90%

options.t: (B) P99 延遲超過 SLO 閾值 (P99 Latency > SLO Threshold)
options.en: (B) P99 Latency > SLO Threshold

options.t: (C) 磁碟使用率 > 70% (Disk Usage > 70%)
options.en: (C) Disk Usage > 70%

options.t: (D) Goroutine 數量突然飆升 (Spike in Goroutine count)
options.en: (D) Spike in Goroutine count

why.t: 緊急告警應針對「使用者症狀 (Symptom)」而非「潛在原因 (Cause)」。延遲過高直接影響使用者體驗，代表系統「壞了」。CPU 或磁碟使用率高是原因，若未影響服務品質，不應在半夜叫醒工程師。
why.en: Emergency alerts should focus on "User Symptoms" rather than "Potential Causes". High latency directly impacts user experience, indicating the system is "broken". High CPU or disk usage are causes; if they don't degrade service quality, they shouldn't wake up an engineer at night.

keywords: Cost Optimization, Storage Strategy, Architecture, Retention

question.t: 您的可觀測性平台正面臨儲存成本過高的問題，目前的架構是將所有的日誌與追蹤資料在高效能儲存層 (如 NVMe SSD) 保留 30 天。
question.en: Your observability platform is facing excessive storage costs. The current architecture retains all logs and trace data on a high-performance storage layer (e.g., NVMe SSD) for 30 days.

question.t: 為了滿足「保留 1 年稽核資料」的法規需求，同時大幅降低成本，下列哪項架構調整最為合適且符合成本效益？
question.en: To meet the regulatory requirement of "retaining audit data for 1 year" while significantly reducing costs, which of the following architectural adjustments is most appropriate and cost-effective?

options.t: (A) 實施分層儲存 (Tiered Storage)：僅將最近 3 天的熱數據存於 SSD，其餘轉存至低成本物件儲存 (如 S3)。
options.en: (A) Implement Tiered Storage: Keep only the last 3 days of hot data on SSDs and offload the rest to low-cost object storage (e.g., S3).

options.t: (B) 將所有資料進行 10% 的隨機採樣 (Random Sampling)，並保留 1 年。
options.en: (B) Apply 10% random sampling to all data and retain it for 1 year.

options.t: (C) 僅保留 Metrics 數據 1 年，完全刪除 Logs 與 Traces。
options.en: (C) Retain only Metrics data for 1 year and completely delete Logs and Traces.

options.t: (D) 使用 GZIP 壓縮所有資料，並繼續存放在高效能 SSD 上。
options.en: (D) Compress all data using GZIP and continue storing it on high-performance SSDs.

why.t: 分層儲存是處理海量可觀測性數據的標準做法。絕大多數的查詢發生在事件發生後的 24-72 小時內 (除錯)，因此熱數據需快存；而長期的稽核資料 (冷數據) 應存放在最便宜的儲存介質上，以平衡效能與成本。
why.en: Tiered storage is the standard practice for handling massive observability data. The vast majority of queries occur within 24-72 hours of an event (debugging), so hot data needs fast storage; long-term audit data (cold data) should be stored on the cheapest medium to balance performance and cost.

question.t: 您的團隊維護一個複雜的微服務系統，雖然儀表板 (Dashboard) 上的 CPU 與記憶體指標皆顯示綠燈 (正常)，但客戶仍不斷抱怨特定操作偶爾會極度緩慢。
question.en: Your team maintains a complex microservices system. Although CPU and memory metrics on the dashboard are all green (normal), customers constantly complain that specific operations are occasionally extremely slow.

question.t: 這種情況反映了傳統「監控 (Monitoring)」與現代「可觀測性 (Observability)」之間的主要差異為何？
question.en: What is the main difference between traditional 'Monitoring' and modern 'Observability' reflected in this situation?

options.t: (A) 監控告訴您系統「是否」壞了 (Known Unknowns)，而可觀測性讓您能詢問系統「為什麼」壞了 (Unknown Unknowns)。
options.en: (A) Monitoring tells you 'if' the system is broken (Known Unknowns), while Observability allows you to ask 'why' it is broken (Unknown Unknowns).

options.t: (B) 監控專注於日誌 (Logs)，而可觀測性專注於指標 (Metrics)。
options.en: (B) Monitoring focuses on Logs, while Observability focuses on Metrics.

options.t: (C) 監控適用於單體架構，可觀測性僅適用於 Serverless 架構。
options.en: (C) Monitoring applies to monolithic architectures, while Observability only applies to Serverless architectures.

options.t: (D) 監控是被動的接收警報，可觀測性是主動的修復程式碼。
options.en: (D) Monitoring is passively receiving alerts, while Observability is actively fixing code.

why.t: 監控通常基於預先定義的聚合指標 (如 CPU 使用率)，只能回答「已知的問題」；可觀測性則透過高基數資料 (High-cardinality data) 允許工程師探索系統內部狀態，找出「未知的根本原因」。
why.en: Monitoring is usually based on pre-defined aggregated metrics (like CPU usage) and can only answer 'known problems'; Observability uses high-cardinality data to allow engineers to explore the internal state of the system and find 'unknown root causes'.

question.t: 您的公司計畫將後端追蹤系統從 Jaeger 遷移至 Grafana Tempo，且未來可能還會更換。
question.en: Your company plans to migrate the backend tracing system from Jaeger to Grafana Tempo, and may switch again in the future.

question.t: 為了避免每次更換後端都需要修改數百個微服務的程式碼，您應該在架構中引入哪個 OpenTelemetry 元件？
question.en: To avoid modifying the code of hundreds of microservices every time the backend changes, which OpenTelemetry component should you introduce in the architecture?

options.t: (A) OTel Collector
options.en: (A) OTel Collector

options.t: (B) Prometheus Node Exporter
options.en: (B) Prometheus Node Exporter

options.t: (C) Service Mesh Sidecar (e.g., Envoy)
options.en: (C) Service Mesh Sidecar (e.g., Envoy)

options.t: (D) Elastic Logstash
options.en: (D) Elastic Logstash

why.t: OpenTelemetry Collector 負責接收應用程式數據、進行處理 (Process) 並匯出 (Export) 到不同的後端。它解耦了應用程式與後端儲存，更換後端時只需修改 Collector 設定檔。
why.en: The OpenTelemetry Collector is responsible for receiving application data, processing it, and exporting it to different backends. It decouples the application from the backend storage, so changing the backend only requires modifying the Collector configuration.

question.t: 您正在觀察 API 延遲的直方圖 (Histogram)，發現 P99 延遲突然飆升。
question.en: You are observing the histogram of API latency and notice a sudden spike in P99 latency.

question.t: 為了直接找出導致該延遲數值的「具體請求 Trace ID」，而不需要在日誌中盲目搜尋，您應該在 Metrics 系統中啟用哪項功能？
question.en: To directly find the 'specific request Trace ID' that caused that latency value without blindly searching in logs, which feature should you enable in the Metrics system?

options.t: (A) Exemplars (範例)
options.en: (A) Exemplars

options.t: (B) High Cardinality Labels
options.en: (B) High Cardinality Labels

options.t: (C) Log Aggregation
options.en: (C) Log Aggregation

options.t: (D) Span Events
options.en: (D) Span Events

why.t: Exemplars 是一種機制，允許在 Metrics (如 Histogram bucket) 中附加特定的 Trace ID 作為樣本。這建立了 Metrics 與 Traces 之間的直接關聯，讓您能從圖表直接跳轉到相關的 Trace。
why.en: Exemplars are a mechanism that allows attaching specific Trace IDs as samples within Metrics (like Histogram buckets). This establishes a direct correlation between Metrics and Traces, allowing you to jump directly from the chart to the relevant Trace.

keywords: Logging, Structured Logging, JSON, Best Practices

question.t: 在 Code Review 中，您看到開發者提交了如上的日誌記錄程式碼 (使用字串格式化)。
question.en: In a Code Review, you see a developer submit the logging code above (using string formatting).

question.t: 身為資深工程師，您建議改用「結構化日誌 (Structured Logging / JSON)」的主要原因為何？
question.en: As a senior engineer, what is the main reason you suggest switching to 'Structured Logging (JSON)'?

options.t: (A) 為了讓日誌系統 (如 ELK/Loki) 能高效率地索引與聚合特定欄位 (如依 user_id 統計錯誤數)。
options.en: (A) To allow log systems (like ELK/Loki) to efficiently index and aggregate specific fields (e.g., count errors by user_id).

options.t: (B) 因為 JSON 格式比純文字佔用更少的儲存空間。
options.en: (B) Because JSON format consumes less storage space than plain text.

options.t: (C) 為了讓人類肉眼閱讀日誌時更舒適。
options.en: (C) To make reading logs more comfortable for human eyes.

options.t: (D) 這是 OpenTelemetry 唯一支援的日誌格式。
options.en: (D) This is the only log format supported by OpenTelemetry.

why.t: 非結構化日誌難以進行機器查詢與統計。結構化日誌將資料視為鍵值對 (Key-Value)，使後端能回答「有多少錯誤來自 User A」這類問題，這對於大規模系統的除錯至關重要。
why.en: Unstructured logs are difficult for machines to query and analyze. Structured logs treat data as Key-Value pairs, enabling the backend to answer questions like 'How many errors came from User A', which is crucial for debugging large-scale systems.

keywords: Distributed Tracing, Context Propagation, Broken Traces, Debugging

question.t: 您在分析一個分散式追蹤 (Trace) 時發現了「斷裂 (Broken Trace)」現象：Trace 顯示 Service A 呼叫了 Service B，但隨後就中斷了，儘管您知道 Service B 確實呼叫了 Service C。
question.en: While analyzing a distributed trace, you encounter a 'Broken Trace': The trace shows Service A calling Service B, but then it stops, even though you know Service B definitely called Service C.

question.t: 最可能的技術原因為何？
question.en: What is the most likely technical reason?

options.t: (A) Service B 在呼叫 Service C 時，沒有正確提取 (Extract) 並注入 (Inject) 追蹤上下文 (Trace Context)。
options.en: (A) Service B did not correctly Extract and Inject the Trace Context when calling Service C.

options.t: (B) Service C 的 CPU 負載過高，導致無法產生 Trace。
options.en: (B) Service C's CPU load was too high, preventing it from generating a Trace.

options.t: (C) Service A 與 Service B 使用了不同版本的 OpenTelemetry SDK。
options.en: (C) Service A and Service B used different versions of the OpenTelemetry SDK.

options.t: (D) 網路防火牆擋住了 Service B 到 Service C 的請求。
options.en: (D) A network firewall blocked the request from Service B to Service C.

why.t: 分散式追蹤依賴「上下文傳播 (Context Propagation)」。如果中間服務 (Service B) 收到請求後，在發起下游呼叫 (Service C) 時沒有將 `traceparent` 等標頭 (Headers) 傳遞下去，Trace ID 就會遺失，導致鏈路斷裂。
why.en: Distributed tracing relies on 'Context Propagation'. If an intermediate service (Service B) receives a request but fails to pass headers like `traceparent` when making a downstream call (Service C), the Trace ID is lost, causing the link to break.

keywords: Cost Optimization, Pre-aggregation, Span Metrics, Architecture

question.t: 您的系統每天產生數十億個 Spans，儲存成本過高。然而，SRE 團隊仍需要精確的服務層級指標 (如 RED Metrics: Rate, Errors, Duration) 來觸發警報。
question.en: Your system generates billions of Spans daily, making storage costs prohibitively high. However, the SRE team still needs accurate service-level metrics (e.g., RED Metrics: Rate, Errors, Duration) to trigger alerts.

question.t: 哪種架構策略能同時滿足「降低儲存成本」與「保留精確指標」的需求？
question.en: Which architectural strategy can satisfy both 'reducing storage costs' and 'retaining accurate metrics'?

options.t: (A) 預聚合 (Pre-aggregation)：在 Collector 層將 Spans 轉換為 Metrics，然後對原始 Spans 進行高比率採樣或丟棄。
options.en: (A) Pre-aggregation: Convert Spans to Metrics at the Collector level, then apply high-rate sampling or drop the raw Spans.

options.t: (B) 僅保留錯誤日誌 (Error Logs)，完全關閉 Tracing 功能。
options.en: (B) Keep only Error Logs and completely disable the Tracing function.

options.t: (C) 將所有 Spans 寫入冷儲存 (Cold Storage, e.g., S3 Glacier) 並直接從該處查詢指標。
options.en: (C) Write all Spans to Cold Storage (e.g., S3 Glacier) and query metrics directly from there.

options.t: (D) 增加 Prometheus 的抓取間隔 (Scrape Interval) 至 5 分鐘。
options.en: (D) Increase the Prometheus scrape interval to 5 minutes.

why.t: 透過在 Collector 進行「Span-to-Metrics」轉換，您可以獲得 100% 流量的統計數據 (Metrics) 用於監控與警報，同時只保留極少量的原始 Trace (如 1% 或僅限錯誤) 用於除錯，從而大幅降低儲存成本。
why.en: By performing 'Span-to-Metrics' conversion at the Collector, you can obtain 100% traffic statistics (Metrics) for monitoring and alerting, while retaining only a very small amount of raw Traces (e.g., 1% or errors only) for debugging, significantly reducing storage costs.

keywords: OpenTelemetry Collector, DaemonSet, Sidecar, Kubernetes, Resource Optimization

question.t: 您的團隊在 Kubernetes 叢集中運行數百個微服務，目前採用 OpenTelemetry Collector 作為 Sidecar 模式部署在每個 Pod 中。
question.en: Your team runs hundreds of microservices in a Kubernetes cluster, currently deploying the OpenTelemetry Collector as a Sidecar in every Pod.

question.t: 您發現這種架構導致整體的記憶體消耗過高，且許多 Collector 實例處於閒置狀態。
question.en: You notice that this architecture results in excessive overall memory consumption, with many Collector instances sitting idle.

question.t: 為了優化資源使用並同時保留添加基礎設施元數據（如 Node Name, Pod Name）的能力，您應該如何調整架構？
question.en: To optimize resource usage while retaining the ability to add infrastructure metadata (e.g., Node Name, Pod Name), how should you adjust the architecture?

options.t: (A) 將 Collector 改為 DaemonSet 模式部署，每個節點運行一個實例。
options.en: (A) Change the Collector deployment to DaemonSet mode, running one instance per node.

options.t: (B) 完全移除 Collector，讓應用程式直接將數據發送到後端儲存。
options.en: (B) Remove the Collector entirely and have applications send data directly to backend storage.

options.t: (C) 增加 Sidecar 的 CPU 與記憶體限制 (Limits) 以提升處理效能。
options.en: (C) Increase the CPU and memory limits for the Sidecars to improve processing performance.

options.t: (D) 僅在生產環境使用 Sidecar，開發環境則關閉可觀測性。
options.en: (D) Use Sidecars only in the production environment and disable observability in the development environment.

why.t: 使用 DaemonSet 模式可以顯著減少 Collector 的總數量（從每個 Pod 一個變為每個 Node 一個），大幅降低資源開銷。同時，DaemonSet 仍能存取該節點的元數據並將其豐富化（Enrichment）到數據中。
why.en: Using DaemonSet mode significantly reduces the total number of Collectors (from one per Pod to one per Node), drastically lowering resource overhead. Meanwhile, the DaemonSet can still access the node's metadata and enrich the data with it.

keywords: Metrics, Aggregation, Histogram, Percentile, P99, Statistics

question.t: 您正在設定 Grafana 儀表板來監控某個微服務的整體效能，該服務部署了 50 個實例 (Instances)。
question.en: You are configuring a Grafana dashboard to monitor the overall performance of a microservice deployed with 50 instances.

question.t: 為了計算「全域 P99 延遲 (Global P99 Latency)」，您嘗試將所有實例回報的 P99 數值進行平均。
question.en: To calculate the 'Global P99 Latency', you attempt to average the P99 values reported by all instances.

question.t: 為什麼這種做法是錯誤的？
question.en: Why is this approach incorrect?

options.t: (A) 因為百分位數 (Percentiles) 無法直接平均；您必須聚合直方圖 (Histogram) 的 Bucket 數據後再重新計算 P99。
options.en: (A) Because percentiles cannot be averaged directly; you must aggregate the Histogram bucket data and then recalculate the P99.

options.t: (B) 因為 P99 只能反映最慢的請求，應該使用平均值 (Mean) 來代表整體效能。
options.en: (B) Because P99 only reflects the slowest requests; the Mean should be used to represent overall performance.

options.t: (C) 因為 Prometheus 不支援跨實例的聚合查詢。
options.en: (C) Because Prometheus does not support cross-instance aggregation queries.

options.t: (D) 這種做法是正確的，只要實例數量夠多，平均值就會趨近於真實分佈。
options.en: (D) This approach is correct; as long as there are enough instances, the average will converge to the true distribution.

why.t: 數學上，百分位數的平均值不等於整體的百分位數（例如：兩個數列的 P99 分別是 100ms 和 200ms，整體的 P99 可能是 150ms，也可能是 200ms，取決於請求分佈）。正確做法是使用 `histogram_quantile` 函數聚合所有 Bucket。
why.en: Mathematically, the average of percentiles is not equal to the percentile of the aggregate (e.g., if P99 of two series are 100ms and 200ms, the global P99 could be 150ms or 200ms depending on distribution). The correct approach is to use the `histogram_quantile` function to aggregate all buckets.

keywords: Auto-instrumentation, Manual Instrumentation, Business Logic, Spans

question.t: 您的團隊為一個 Java 應用程式啟用了 OpenTelemetry 自動儀表化 (Auto-instrumentation Agent)。
question.en: Your team has enabled the OpenTelemetry Auto-instrumentation Agent for a Java application.

question.t: 在 Trace 視圖中，您清楚看到了 HTTP 入口請求與資料庫查詢的 Spans，但這兩者之間有一段很長的空白時間，對應到一段複雜的內部計費邏輯。
question.en: In the Trace view, you clearly see Spans for incoming HTTP requests and database queries, but there is a long gap between them corresponding to complex internal billing logic.

question.t: 為了填補這段可觀測性盲區，最佳做法是什麼？
question.en: What is the best practice to fill this observability blind spot?

options.t: (A) 在該計費邏輯函式中加入手動埋點 (Manual Instrumentation)，建立一個新的 Child Span。
options.en: (A) Add Manual Instrumentation to the billing logic function to create a new Child Span.

options.t: (B) 增加日誌詳細度 (Log Level) 至 DEBUG，並依賴日誌來推算耗時。
options.en: (B) Increase the Log Level to DEBUG and rely on logs to estimate the duration.

options.t: (C) 配置 Agent 對所有 Java 方法進行 Profiling，自動產生所有函式的 Spans。
options.en: (C) Configure the Agent to profile all Java methods and automatically generate Spans for every function.

options.t: (D) 忽略這段時間，因為它屬於 CPU 密集運算，不涉及 I/O。
options.en: (D) Ignore this period because it is CPU-intensive computation and does not involve I/O.

why.t: 自動儀表化通常只能覆蓋標準框架（如 Spring, JDBC）。對於特定領域的業務邏輯（Domain Logic），必須透過手動埋點來建立 Span，以便在 Trace 中視覺化該段邏輯的執行時間與狀態。
why.en: Auto-instrumentation usually only covers standard frameworks (e.g., Spring, JDBC). For domain-specific business logic, you must use manual instrumentation to create Spans to visualize the execution time and status of that logic in the Trace.

keywords: W3C Trace Context, Interoperability, Headers, Distributed Tracing

question.t: 您的服務 A (使用 OpenTelemetry) 呼叫了由另一個團隊維護的服務 B (使用舊版專有追蹤工具)。
question.en: Your Service A (using OpenTelemetry) calls Service B (maintained by another team using a legacy proprietary tracing tool).

question.t: 您發現 Trace 在服務 A 與服務 B 之間斷開了，無法串聯成一個完整的交易路徑。
question.en: You find that the Trace is broken between Service A and Service B, failing to link into a complete transaction path.

question.t: 最可能的根本原因是什麼？
question.en: What is the most likely root cause?

options.t: (A) 雙方使用的 HTTP 傳播標頭 (Propagation Headers) 標準不一致（例如 W3C Trace Context vs B3）。
options.en: (A) The HTTP Propagation Headers standards used by both sides are inconsistent (e.g., W3C Trace Context vs B3).

options.t: (B) 服務 B 的資料庫寫入速度太慢，導致 Trace 超時。
options.en: (B) Service B's database write speed is too slow, causing the Trace to timeout.

options.t: (C) 兩個服務位於不同的可用區域 (Availability Zone)。
options.en: (C) The two services are located in different Availability Zones.

options.t: (D) OpenTelemetry 不支援追蹤 HTTP GET 請求。
options.en: (D) OpenTelemetry does not support tracing HTTP GET requests.

why.t: 分散式追蹤依賴 HTTP 標頭來傳遞 TraceID。如果發送方使用 W3C 標準 (`traceparent`) 而接收方只認得 B3 (`x-b3-traceid`) 或其他專有格式，Context 就會遺失。解決方案是配置傳播器 (Propagators) 以支援多種標準。
why.en: Distributed tracing relies on HTTP headers to propagate TraceIDs. If the sender uses the W3C standard (`traceparent`) and the receiver only recognizes B3 (`x-b3-traceid`) or other proprietary formats, the Context will be lost. The solution is to configure Propagators to support multiple standards.

keywords: Logs, Cost Optimization, Storage Tiering, Retention Policy

question.t: 根據法規要求，您的系統日誌 (Logs) 必須保存至少一年以供稽核。
question.en: According to regulatory requirements, your system logs must be retained for at least one year for auditing.

question.t: 然而，將所有日誌存放在高效能的 Elasticsearch/Loki 叢集中一年，成本高得無法接受。
question.en: However, keeping all logs in a high-performance Elasticsearch/Loki cluster for a year is prohibitively expensive.

question.t: 作為資深工程師，您應建議採取哪種儲存策略？
question.en: As a senior engineer, what storage strategy should you recommend?

options.t: (A) 實施分層儲存 (Tiered Storage)：近期日誌存於熱儲存，超過一定天數（如 7 天）後歸檔至物件儲存 (S3/GCS)。
options.en: (A) Implement Tiered Storage: Keep recent logs in hot storage and archive logs older than a certain period (e.g., 7 days) to Object Storage (S3/GCS).

options.t: (B) 僅保留錯誤 (ERROR) 等級的日誌，丟棄所有 INFO 與 DEBUG 日誌。
options.en: (B) Retain only ERROR level logs and discard all INFO and DEBUG logs.

options.t: (C) 對日誌進行高壓縮比壓縮，並繼續存放在 Elasticsearch 的 SSD 節點上。
options.en: (C) Compress logs with a high compression ratio and continue storing them on Elasticsearch SSD nodes.

options.t: (D) 移除日誌中的時間戳記以節省儲存空間。
options.en: (D) Remove timestamps from logs to save storage space.

why.t: 分層儲存是平衡成本與查詢需求的標準做法。絕大多數的查詢發生在日誌產生後的幾天內（熱數據），而稽核用的歷史數據（冷數據）可以存放在成本極低的物件儲存中，需要時再回存或使用特定工具查詢。
why.en: Tiered storage is the standard practice to balance cost and query needs. The vast majority of queries occur within days of log generation (hot data), while historical data for auditing (cold data) can be stored in extremely low-cost object storage and restored or queried with specific tools when needed.
